name: Yucaipa Pointe
demographics: Yucaipa Pointe serves a suburban family-oriented demographic in the Inland Empire, drawing primarily from middle-income households in Yucaipa and surrounding San Bernardino County communities. The trade area attracts a mix of young families and retirees seeking convenient neighborhood shopping, with visitors typically prioritizing value and accessibility. The center caters to everyday shopping needs with a focus on practical retail and services that appeal to budget-conscious consumers in this growing residential market.
description: Yucaipa Pointe is a neighborhood shopping center located at 31495 Yucaipa Boulevard in Yucaipa, California, professionally managed by The REMM Group, a leading commercial property management firm based in Orange County. As part of REMM's diverse retail portfolio spanning Southern California, Yucaipa Pointe serves the local community with convenient access to everyday shopping and services. The center benefits from The REMM Group's extensive expertise in commercial property management, which includes overseeing numerous retail centers, office buildings, and industrial properties throughout the region. With a strong 5-star rating from customer reviews, Yucaipa Pointe has established itself as a trusted shopping destination in the Yucaipa area. The REMM Group's commitment to excellence in property management ensures that tenants and visitors alike experience well-maintained facilities and professional service at this Inland Empire location.
